title: Autonomous discovery of L1–ibuprofen association in DMSO
difficulty_reasons: The Agent must formulate and search multiple binding hypotheses without a supplied binding site or preferred interaction motif.
A broad conformer and encounter-geometry space must be reduced while validating solution thermochemistry and optical response.

paper.title: Synthesis and binding studies of two new coumarin-squaramide-based receptors for NSAIDs

data.description: Self-contained component identities, charges, multiplicities, 1:1 stoichiometry, solvent, temperature, and stereochemical boundary.

required_deliverables.description: Machine-readable hypothesis search, candidate validation, computed observables, conclusion, and limitations.
